lede: Wat Walukaram accounts for 30 catalogued manuscripts. It clusters in Chiang Mai (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (100%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. Dated witnesses run 1895–1981 CE (22 of 30 carry a date).
